name: Drafts
description: Editable channel drafts (staff brief / IG story / store sign) tied to an approved action, kept behind a review gate until approved.

agentPrompts.label: Show me a channel draft to review
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-retail-intel` skill in this folder, then show me the draft I name (staff brief / IG story / store sign), its linked action, and any risk badge.

agentPrompts.label: Revise a draft's wording
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-retail-intel` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then rewrite the draft I name per the edit I describe and save it as `edited-body` on the same record, without inventing a claim, price, or inventory promise I didn't give you.

agentPrompts.label: Approve, request changes, or block a draft
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-retail-intel` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record my decision (approve / request_changes / block) and comment on the draft I name. This never publishes anything by itself — that only happens after `execute_decisions.mjs --apply` and a real outbound handoff.
